notes.title: Two new LMS tiles Wednesday
notes.text: Pre-Programme Newsletter #9 says you will be enrolled in two more tiles by Wednesday. The Student Life one carries the immigration, visa and medical insurance material and the Fontainebleau guide. - Worth opening the LMS before you fly, since that is the day it lands.

notes.itemTitle: Apply: Amazon Launch MBA intern, Luxembourg
notes.title: Amazon session is tomorrow
notes.text: Amazon's info session on Pathways and Launch is tomorrow, and INSEAD says to apply straight after because the roles fill on a rolling basis. Your Launch application is dated the 8th and you fly on Wednesday. - Worth doing the application the same evening as the session.
